# `internal`

The platform failed, and the reason is not sent.

| Status | Title | `type` |
|---|---|---|
| `500` | Internal error | `https://substrat.net/errors/internal` |

## What it means

A throw nobody declared a code for. The body never carries `detail`. A message nobody reviewed may hold another tenant's data, so the sentence goes to the platform's log and not to the caller. `requestId` is how the two are joined up again.

## When it is returned

- A throw that declared no code, on a surface that answers one as its own fault: the control plane and the builder. A vertical answers an untyped throw as the caller's `400` in the `about:blank` form instead.
- A throw that declared `internal` itself.

## What it carries

- Nothing beyond the members every problem carries.

See [the body](/errors/#the-body) for the members any problem may carry.

## What to do

Retry a read once. A write is safe to repeat only when it was sent with an `Idempotency-Key` to an operation whose `/openapi.json` documents that header, and the retry sends the same key. Not every surface honours the header, so elsewhere check whether the first attempt took effect before sending it again. If the retry fails too, or the request is not safe to repeat, report it and quote `requestId`, which the dashboard's request view opens.

## In `/openapi.json`

Documented on every operation's failure responses.
